messages:
Liam (Finance): Heads up 1: BillingBot flagged a $7,220 orphaned GPU charge in asia-southeast1 last night. Appears tied to a partner-licensed model cache image (vendor-ml-cache) that should have used partner billing but didn't. Need attribution and vendor confirmation before we invoice/credit.
BillingBot: ALERT: 2026-05-11 21:42 UTC - ORPHAN_GPU - $7,220 - 10 GPUs - projects: 3 - details: /billing/alerts/20260511-77
Tess (Platform): I'm pulling the usage export. My initial hunch: the image includes a STARTUP script that sets billing_project to partner account, but our image-pull proxy rewrote metadata and removed the billing override.
Meera (ML Eng): We launched a distributed training job for 'multilingual-qa' using vendor-ml-cache; job id 7721. I thought partner-billing would be applied. I also used the shared-cache bucket.
Hassan (SRE): We rolled out cache-proxy v1.10 yesterday which changes metadata passthrough behavior. Rolling back to v1.9 might re-enable the override. Opening PR to revert.
Tess (Platform): Query to map costs by image and project:
```
SELECT image_name, project_id, SUM(gpu_hours) as gpu_h, SUM(cost) as cost
FROM billing.gpu_usage_v2
WHERE date = '2026-05-11' AND region = 'asia-southeast1' AND label_billed_to IS NULL
GROUP BY image_name, project_id
ORDER BY cost DESC;
```
Tess (Platform): Results: vendor-ml-cache on project shared-cache-prod = $5,400; multilingual-qa on sandbox-team = $1,000; misc infra housekeeping = $820.
Liam (Finance): So $5.4k likely partner-licensed and needs retro-assignment to partner's billing code. The rest we can tag to internal teams. What's ETA to re-tag/export?
Priya (CostOps): We have an automated backfill but vendor metadata wasn't captured. I can run a targeted backfill against image_name=vendor-ml-cache and date range. ETA ~35m. I'll also flag partner projects so alerts don't auto-credit.
Meera (ML Eng): Confirm job 7721 belongs to partner 'lingua-inc' POC and should be billed to partner account. Happy to provide run manifests.
VendorBot: NOTICE: lingua-inc has a usage cap and negotiated discount (15%) on vendor-licensed images; please confirm attribution before invoicing. Contact: partnerships@lingua-inc.com
Rita (CFO): Approve provisional assignment to lingua-inc pending verification. We should hold off invoice until vendor confirms discounted rate applies. If audit shows partner should have been charged, apply 15% discount to that portion and issue adjusted invoice/credit note.
Hassan (SRE): Rolling back cache-proxy now. Will also add validation in the image-pull flow to preserve billing metadata. PR in review.
Tess (Platform): Backfill kicked off by Priya. Command used:
```
/tools/costops backfill --image vendor-ml-cache --from 2026-05-11 --to 2026-05-11 --set-label label_billed_to=lingua-inc
```
Tess (Platform): Backfill progress: 60% complete. Estimated finish 20m. Will push CSV of assignments to FIN-1402.
Liam (Finance): Opening FIN-1402 to track: 1) vendor attribution, 2) apply 15% negotiated discount if confirmed, 3) produce credit memo or invoice delta for lingua-inc, 4) document internal reallocations.
Priya (CostOps): After backfill we should run the invoice-delta script to compute net delta and draft the credit memo. I'll attach the pre-discount and post-discount numbers.
Meera (ML Eng): Action: I'll paste job manifests to FIN-1402 and ping partnerships for vendor confirmation.
Rita (CFO): Also ask Legal to check contract clause re: vendor discount eligibility for POC runs. CC finance on reply.
BillingBot: FIN-1402 created and tagged @Liam (Finance).
Tess (Platform): Backfill finished. Diff: $5,400 -> assigned to lingua-inc, $1,000 -> sandbox-team, $820 -> infra-team. CSV uploaded /billing/exports/20260511-cache-backfill.csv
Priya (CostOps): Running invoice-delta: pre-discount $5,400; applying 15% vendor discount -> $4,590. Proposed credit/invoice delta to lingua-inc: $810 credit (if they were charged), or issue invoice for $4,590 if not charged. Pushing numbers to FIN-1402.
Liam (Finance): Draft credit memo for $810 and hold until vendor confirms. For internal items, allocate to sandbox and infra budgets.
Rita (CFO): Approved to proceed with credit memo draft and contract check. If vendor denies discount, we'll invoice lingua-inc for full $5,400 and note operational remediation.
Hassan (SRE): Action: revert in prod completed, PR merged for metadata passthrough test, will add a monitoring alert for any image pulls that strip billing metadata.
Priya (CostOps): Action: add nightly 'vendor-untagged' sweep report and set alert threshold to $2k/day for partner-licensed images.
Liam (Finance): Recap actions: FIN-1402 tracks vendor attribution, Priya runs invoice-delta, Meera provides manifests and pings vendor, Tess/Pryia/ Hassan fixed proxy and backfill, Rita/legal to confirm contract. I'll update FIN-1402 with draft credit memo and notify partnerships if confirmed. Thanks all :thumbsup:
